title: iabft-behavioral-fairness-index: Behavioral Fairness Index (BFI) for Online Examinations under Infrastructure Disruption
description: Reproduction code for the paper 'When the Recorded Score Is Not the Evidence: An Axiomatic Behavioral Fairness Index for Online Examinations under Infrastructure Disruption'. Implements the gated Behavioral Fairness Index BFI = alpha*P + beta*R + gamma*[1 - (1 - P)*Dhat], the evidence-gated decision rule, unit tests of Axioms A1-A6, the stability analysis (Theorem T5), validity and robustness analyses, an ablation of the linear specification, and the scripts for Figures 1-4. Running src/run_all.py on the Zenodo dataset (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20366538) reproduces every number, table and figure in the paper. Versions 1.x and 2.x are superseded and should not be used to reproduce the paper.
